description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android app that generates and displays a color palette. It handles UI initialization, palette generation, theme toggling, copy-to-clipboard functionality, and color transitions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing UI for color palette generation, theme switching, and clipboard actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets click listeners, and generates the initial color palette.

methods.name: requestAllowed
methods.description: Prevents frequent palette generation requests by debouncing.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark theme modes with user feedback.

methods.name: generateAndRenderPalette
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a color palette and updates the UI, with optional animation.

methods.name: renderPalette
methods.description: Updates the palette display tiles with new colors, applying transitions if animated.

methods.name: crossfade
methods.description: Performs a fade-in animation for color transition, respecting system reduced motion settings.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies color values to clipboard and shows confirmation Snackbar.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up coroutine scope on activity destruction.
